verdict.rationale: Evidence indirectly shows both USB-A and USB-C variants exist (the shop page references 'nk3an-nitrokey-3a-nfc' and a community comment mentions ordering a 'Nitrokey 3C NFC'), suggesting the lineup covers both port types. However, there is no evidence of keychain or nano low-profile form factors anywhere in the pack, and one community comment even complains about waiting years for a Type-C model, casting some doubt on breadth/availability. Missing for 10: explicit nano/keychain form-factor SKUs, confirmed current availability of USB-C models, first-party spec sheet comparing form factors.
